# Resonance Lab source intake

Copyright (c) 2026 Christian Ströbele (CrispStrobe). SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-3-Clause.

These are unmodified source files from the Resonance Lab BSD release identified
in `source.json`. The installed LDR, MPD, three programs and full author grant
are byte-identical copies. The arrangement contains 142 rigid placements and two
physical rubber-band loops, one SPIKE motor on A and one mounted SPIKE hub.

`assembly/BUILD-STEPS.md`, `geometry.json`, `parts.csv`, `generate_model.py` and
`mechanism_geometry.py` preserve the original complete construction source.
`lessons/` preserves the original source prose. The app's authored lesson
profiles live in `docs/data/robot-lab-lessons.json`; their generated variants
use automatic Blocks loading and links between the three experiment choices.
The full copyright grant and originality record remain in `LICENSE`,
`THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` and `SOURCES.txt`.

The source release's runtime measurements belong to its recorded application
revision, `df32b7ff33595406ce7356d249ec61baec1fecf6`. Its original evidence is
preserved in that separate release and is not copied into this fixture as a
claim about a newer app build. The current app integration starts at
`c015fd7fcad8964c1266c182ca00bc7d163f7b28`. Native program, browser and hardware
qualification remain separate from these byte-identity and registration checks.

No external part mesh, runtime binary, CAD-derived preview or noncommercial
asset is included here. Standard LDraw geometry remains separately licensed.
